items.q: How quickly can we get our team trained?
items.a: Most teams are up and running within an hour. Buy a plan, invite your team by email or CSV upload, and learners can start the same day. Courses take 1-2 hours each, so a full team can be certified within a week.

items.q: Do we need to install anything?
items.a: No. Train321 runs entirely in the browser — desktop, tablet, or phone. Learners don't need an account beyond their training login, and managers manage everything from a dashboard.

items.q: Can I try it before buying?
items.a: Yes. Every course has a free preview module so you can see exactly what your team will experience. You can also request a live demo with our team.
